chapter: New Orleans style and bass playing
title: Tricky pianists: Hines and Don Ewell
summary: Hines changes keys without warning, and Garland describes how he and Don Ewell traded signals for breaks over twelve years.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
